shared_elements: large low-relief panel with figures filling the field
figure holding an object in raised/extended hand
stylized beard and hair rendered as rows of curls
held plant or floral element (flower/cone-like object)
justification: Both depict large-scale profile standing figures in low relief with rows of tightly curled beard/hair, patterned headgear, fringed robes, bracelets, and a small object (cone/flower) raised in an extended hand — a very specific shared convention of the courtly attendant figure. The main differences are that A shows a single winged, bird-headed composite being with a bucket-like handled vessel, while B shows a file of repeated ordinary human heads with tall fluted caps and no wings, plus a decorative rosette band.
